# Tele-GEMS

[Tele-Global Examination of Mental State]{.sub}
:::

::: {.chips}
[<i class="bi bi-telephone"></i> Remote, by telephone]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-clock"></i> About 10 minutes]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-list-check"></i> 10 tasks]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-files"></i> Parallel forms A and B]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-people"></i> 601 adults, 18+ years]{.chip}
:::

::: {.prose}
Tele-GEMS is a telephone-based cognitive screening, developed as the remote counterpart of GEMS.
It mirrors the structure and items of the in-person test as closely as possible, so remote and in-person assessments can be compared, for example in follow-ups after a first assessment with GEMS.

Its 10 tasks cover **orientation, immediate and delayed memory, working memory (backward months), spatial representation, naming, verbal comprehension, auditory attention, verbal fluency** and **metaphor comprehension**.
Cut-offs account for age, sex, education and the **Cognitive Reserve Index**. An online Shiny app computes them automatically.
:::
